newsHighlights.title: Mooncake: A small festive pastry with a long and rich history
newsHighlights.summary: Mooncakes, the small festive pastries of the Mid-Autumn Festival, carry a long and rich history while raising modern questions about sugar, calories and healthy eating.
newsHighlights.translation: 月饼——这一中秋节的节令糕点，承载着悠久而丰富的历史，同时也引发了人们对糖分、热量与健康饮食的现代思考。

newsHighlights.title: Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan dies at 63
newsHighlights.summary: Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan, beloved singer and professor, died at the age of 63, prompting nationwide mourning and renewed attention to health and work-life balance.
newsHighlights.translation: 深受喜爱的中国资深音乐人、歌手兼教授刘欢因病辞世，享年63岁，举国哀悼，也再度引发公众对健康与工作生活平衡的关注。

newsHighlights.title: Xi, Peng Liyuan have tea chat with Trump and his wife
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan enjoyed a relaxed tea chat with Donald Trump and his wife at the White House, highlighting tea as a symbol of a slow, healthy lifestyle.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席和彭丽媛同特朗普夫妇在白宫轻松品茶畅谈，茶由此成为慢节奏、健康生活方式的一种象征。

newsHighlights.title: EMSC: '5.6-magnitude earthquake hits NEW IRELAND REGION, P.N.G.'
newsHighlights.summary: A 5.6-magnitude earthquake struck the New Ireland region of Papua New Guinea, reminding the world of the importance of disaster preparedness and first-aid knowledge.
newsHighlights.translation: 巴布亚新几内亚新爱尔兰地区发生5.6级地震，再次提醒世人防灾准备与急救知识的重要性。

newsHighlights.title: Going for gold at WorldSkills competition
newsHighlights.summary: Young craftspeople went for gold at the WorldSkills competition, showing that physical stamina, focus and a healthy daily routine are the foundation of professional excellence.
newsHighlights.translation: 年轻的技能人才在世界技能大赛上冲击金牌，表明充沛的体力、专注力和健康的日常作息是职业卓越的基石。

quote.quote: Health is the greatest possession. Contentment is the greatest treasure.
quote.author: Lao Tzu
quote.translation: 健康是最大的财富，知足是最大的宝藏。
quote.explanation: 老子认为，物质财富终会流逝，而健康的身体和内心的满足才是人生真正可靠、持久的资本。这与今日新闻中对月饼节庆饮食的适度提醒、以及对刘欢先生离世后公众关注健康的反思高度契合。

vocabulary.definition: 糕点；油酥面点（常用复数 pastries）
vocabulary.example: Mooncake is a small festive pastry with a long and rich history.
vocabulary.translation: 月饼是一种有着悠久而丰富历史的节令糕点。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道标题：Mooncake: A small festive pastry with a long and rich history

vocabulary.example: Families gather to share festive food and admire the full moon during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
vocabulary.translation: 中秋节期间，家人们团聚在一起分享节日美食、共赏满月。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 月饼报道中的 "a small festive pastry"

vocabulary.example: Mooncakes carry the cultural heritage of the Mid-Autumn Festival.
vocabulary.translation: 月饼承载着中秋节的文化传统。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 月饼报道中对其 "a long and rich history" 的描述

vocabulary.definition: 适度；节制（in moderation 意为“适量地”）
vocabulary.example: Doctors advise enjoying mooncakes in moderation because they are high in sugar and fat.
vocabulary.translation: 医生建议适量食用月饼，因为其糖分和脂肪含量较高。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 CGTN 月饼报道中关于节庆饮食与健康的讨论

vocabulary.example: A mooncake is an occasional indulgence rather than an everyday snack.
vocabulary.translation: 月饼是偶尔的享受，而非日常零食。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 CGTN 月饼报道中对高热量糕点食用方式的建议

vocabulary.example: A balanced diet and regular exercise are linked to greater longevity.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡的饮食和规律的运动与更长的寿命相关。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 ChinaDaily 关于刘欢辞世报道引发的公众对长寿与健康的反思

vocabulary.definition: 经验丰富的人，老手；资深的
vocabulary.example: Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan died at 63, leaving behind a rich musical legacy.
vocabulary.translation: 中国资深音乐人刘欢辞世，享年63岁，留下了丰富的音乐遗产。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道标题：Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan dies at 63

vocabulary.example: Fans across the country mourn the loss of the beloved singer.
vocabulary.translation: 全国各地的歌迷哀悼这位深受爱戴的歌手的离世。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 关于刘欢辞世后公众反应的报道

vocabulary.example: A 5.6-magnitude earthquake hit the New Ireland region of Papua New Guinea.
vocabulary.translation: 一场5.6级地震袭击了巴布亚新几内亚的新爱尔兰地区。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 地震快讯：'5.6-magnitude earthquake hits NEW IRELAND REGION, P.N.G.'

vocabulary.example: Community resilience is vital after an earthquake strikes.
vocabulary.translation: 地震发生后，社区的抗灾恢复力至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 CGTN 地震报道中关于防灾准备与灾后恢复的讨论

pattern.pattern: a/an + 名词 + with a long and rich history（作同位语，用于描述某事物具有悠久历史）
pattern.example: Mooncake, a small festive pastry with a long and rich history, is shared by families across China during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
pattern.translation: 月饼，这种有着悠久而丰富历史的节令糕点，在中秋节期间被全国家庭共同分享。
pattern.usage: 该结构用一个同位语短语简洁地补充说明主语的身份与特征，常见于新闻标题和导语。写作时可用于介绍传统食物、节日或文化现象，例如：Tea, a daily drink with a long and rich history, is now praised for its health benefits.

grammar.title: 同位语（Appositive）
grammar.explanation: 同位语是紧跟在名词（或代词）之后、对其进行解释或补充说明的成分，通常由名词短语充当，前后常用逗号隔开。同位语可使句子更紧凑、信息更密集，是英语新闻写作中最常用的结构之一。注意同位语必须与其说明的名词在人称和数上保持一致。
examples: Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan, a beloved singer and professor, died at 63.
Mooncake, a small festive pastry with a long and rich history, remains popular today.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第二个音节 -gev- 上，读作 lon-JEV-uh-tee。注意第一个音节是短元音 /ɒ/，中间是 /dʒ/ 而非 /g/，结尾为 /əti/，切勿读成“long-gev-i-ty”或把重音放在首音节。
examples: A healthy lifestyle can contribute to longevity.
Scientists are studying the secrets of longevity in mountain villages.

reading.title: Mooncakes, Tea and the Art of Healthy Celebration
reading.content:
Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunions, and no celebration is complete without mooncakes. As CGTN reports, the mooncake is a small festive pastry with a long and rich history, dating back centuries. Today, however, nutritionists remind us that this traditional treat is high in sugar and fat. Enjoying one or two slices with tea, rather than a whole cake alone, is a healthier choice.

Tea itself has become a global symbol of wellness. During President Xi Jinping's visit to the United States, leaders of the two countries sat down for a relaxed tea chat at the White House — proof that a simple cup of tea can slow down even the busiest day.

This week, the sudden death of veteran musician Liu Huan at 63 also reminded millions of fans to value their health. Work hard, rest well, eat with moderation, and cherish the people around you. After all, health is the greatest possession of all.
reading.translation:
中秋节是家人团聚的时刻，而没有月饼的庆祝是不完整的。正如 CGTN 报道所言，月饼是一种有着悠久而丰富历史的节令糕点，可追溯至数百年前。然而今天，营养学家提醒我们，这一传统美食糖分和脂肪含量较高。配上茶享用一两块，而非独自吃掉一整块，是更健康的选择。

茶本身也已成为全球性的健康象征。在习近平主席访美期间，两国元首在白宫轻松品茶畅谈——这证明，一杯清茶甚至能让最忙碌的一天慢下来。

本周，资深音乐人刘欢在63岁突然离世，也让无数歌迷意识到健康的可贵。努力工作，好好休息，饮食有度，珍惜身边的人。毕竟，健康才是最大的财富。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 CGTN《Mooncake: A small festive pastry with a long and rich history》、ChinaDaily《Veteran Chinese musician Liu Huan dies at 63》以及《Xi, Peng Liyuan have tea chat with Trump and his wife》三篇当日新闻改写，用于英语学习目的。
